relation_weights: Equal within each cohort and cross-task/self-invariance category. First fixed-length mean per source; then equal mean across source seeds; then equal mean across relation IDs. No adaptive exclusions.
missing_rule: Complete-length mean only; undefined values retained in detailed tables. Metric agreement uses only cells defined for all three primary metrics and reports coverage.
leave_one_family: Within cohort and cross-task category, remove all relations in each dependent mathematical family; average remaining relation means equally. Purely descriptive, no independent-relation CI.
direction: Report signs of Bt and Delta independently; use negative NRMSE for Procrustes. No comparison of numeric scales across metrics.
source_uncertainty: Mean,median,range,standard deviation across available sources describe initialization/basis variation, not new independent input universes; no significance/equivalence tests.
k_summary: Fixed 1/29 length mean requires all29 defined. R0-R2 source seeds and R3/R4 fixedseed subset sensitivities separate. Pooled original-cache results are contrast only.
